Who we are

The humans
behind Pílar

Educators, doulas, creatives & advocates — building the space we wished had existed for us.

Kimberly Górskie-Garcia

she / her

A French mom of three, a baby nurse, and a birth doula. At seventeen she founded a nonprofit supporting children with cancer. Her career spans senior care, neonatal nursing in France, and doula practice in the United States.

Her approach centers on making sure people feel heard, respected, and supported across every caregiving context — and she believes in art as a way to talk about history, justice and equity with the next generation.

"While I fully intend to be that fierce 90-year-old still showing up to protest, I'd much rather carry a sign that says: 'Look how far we've come.'"

Samantha Bossu

she / they

A fiery empath, lifelong learner, and passionate advocate for equity and justice. A birthworker and sexual health coach, Samantha centers matriarchal values and reproductive justice in all of her work.

Her background includes elementary and special education, doula certification through Birthing Advocacy Doula Trainings, and sexuality education study under Tiffany Yelverton.

"Whether I'm supporting someone through birth, facilitating conversations about sexuality, or advocating for equitable care — my goal stays the same."

Come build this feminist future with us.
